pages.text: Out in the country, now and then, you find a little timber $(thing)ham shack$() with a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/vhf_antennas)J-pole$(/l) on its flat roof. Look in plains, forests, meadows, taiga, snowy plains, savanna and the hills. A few villages (plains, taiga, snowy, savanna and desert) have one too, built in the village's own wood, with a villager living in it.$(br2)Whoever lived there is long gone: the station is dark, the radio off and its battery flat.

pages.title: What is inside
pages.text: $(li)A $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_base_station)VHF base station$(/l), switched off, on 146.520 MHz (the 2 m calling frequency), coax up to the J-pole, and a flat large battery: charge it or bring power before you switch on.$(li)A $(l:radiocraft:computer/radio_computer)radio computer$(/l) with its monitor, the Logbook and Frequency Manager installed.$(li)A chest of radio parts: cores, speakers, microphones, crystals, a band plan, blank floppies. Old hams kept odd things in there too.$(br2)Everything in it is yours to keep or move.
